description: List the pinned messages of a channel or thread, newest pin first, each with its pin time. To pin a message use discord_create_pin, and to unpin use discord_delete_pin. Page with before=next_before while has_more is true. Bot permissions it may need: View Channel, Read Message History. Read-only; safe to retry.

before.description: ISO 8601 date and time with seconds, for example 2026-11-05T18:00:00Z; cursor to fetch pins created before this time (use next_before)

channel_id.description: ID of the channel or thread to list pinned messages from

limit.description: Max number of pinned messages to return (1-50; default is 50)

name: discord_list_pins
